title_zh: 约好试听找回的录音副本

scenario.label_zh: 约好试听找回的录音副本
scenario.goal_zh: 回应朋友对录音恢复的期待，并约定试听副本后再判断内容是否完整

context_zh: 朋友找到一份以为丢失的家庭录音备份，邀请另一人一起检查。
author: author-phase11-c

sentences.speaker: Dina
sentences.text: The backup folder has a file with my grandfather’s name on it. It feels like a miracle after all that searching.

sentences.speaker: Marco
sentences.text: That’s a reason for optimism, but the file name doesn’t tell us whether the recording still plays.

sentences.speaker: Dina
sentences.text: You’re right. I wanted to persist with the search, but I was starting to give up.

sentences.speaker: Marco
sentences.text: Let’s play a copy, so we leave the backup untouched. We can listen together this evening.

sentences.speaker: Dina
sentences.text: I’d like that. If it’s only a few minutes of his voice, I still want to hear it.

sentences.speaker: Marco
sentences.text: Come over at seven. We’ll find out what’s actually there before we celebrate the whole recording.

targets.sense_zh: 令人惊喜的奇迹般事件
